dct_description_sm: A scanned map sheet that has been georeferenced, so it is previewable two ways: as an image to page through, and as a layer warped onto its ground control points. One resource, two tabs.

The georeference annotation is not named in dct_references_s at all. It is reachable only through the manifest, whose canvas links an annotation page whose painting annotation carries the Allmaps page as its body - the shape Stanford's purl generates at request time.
dct_creator_sm: Great Britain. War Office. General Staff. Geographical Section.
